title: jsnode-package 0.5.0: YAML front matter; suite to zero failures
body: Translator strips a leading --- front matter block and counts it in every sourceSpan; unterminated block refused (INVALID_FRONT_MATTER). Data 0.7.0. Suite: 226 pass, 0 fail, 5 skipped (requires a local registry at 127.0.0.1:4873). Fixed real drift: the CLI binding omitted src/project-jsnode-module-paths.mjs and the schema external reference; the house-resolver runner is found in the installed package when the forest sibling is absent.
